Subject: Re-kick: MAP, roles, and proposed 6-week evaluation plan (Ava Solutions)

Hi Samira / Jordan — great to e-meet you, Samira. Thanks for the intro, Jordan.

Samira: Im Sofia (Account Executive) and Im taking point on re-kicking the mutual action plan so we can land the PoC and procurement quickly. Ben and Grace (Solutions/CS) are copied to cover technical and success criteria.

Short summary and ask:
- Context: Work paused after your Platform re-org in late June. The MAP in Bens note reflects our prior alignment; well update scope to account for any new constraints.
- Goal: 6-week evaluation (PoC) to validate latency and cost targets for your headline ingestion pipeline; target contract close within 8–10 weeks after successful PoC.
- Immediate ask: confirm Samira as champion and availability for a 45-min kickoff next Tue/Wed (Aug 11–12).

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Week 0: Kickoff + environment access / data share checklist (security contact identified)
2) Weeks 1–3: PoC runs — sample workload + performance benchmarks (Redwood provides runner config and scripts)
3) Week 4: Quality review + acceptance test run (shared metrics dashboard)
4) Week 5: Procurement & pricing review (Procurement + Redwood finance)
5) Week 6: Final decision & contract input (DocuSign packet prepared)

Attached: AVA_MAP_rekick.pdf (condensed MAP), Evaluation_Checklist_Aug2026.docx (quick security & access checklist). Ben will own technical deliverables; Grace will coordinate success criteria and dashboards.

Action items (please reply inline):
- Samira: confirm champion & pick two kickoff slots (we offered Aug 11 10am PT or Aug 12 11am PT)
- Procurement: tell us if your standard PO timing or information needs have changed since June
- Ben/Grace: well update the MAP post-kickoff with owner assignments and milestone dates

Links: HubSpot record (https://hubspot.example/contacts/AVAS-58) and draft DocuSign packet (https://app.redwood/docusign/packet/AVAS-58).

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to the next stage.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
